Dunn & Acosta LLP

Settlement Demand
21 Sep 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1217 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our firm represents Megan Gutierrez in connection with injuries sustained in a
collision that occurred on 18 Oct 2023 at a signalized intersection. Our client was
proceeding lawfully through the intersection when your insured failed to yield the
right of way and struck the driver's side of our client's vehicle. The police report
and the physical damage to both vehicles are consistent with our client's account of
the event.
As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a serious shoulder injury.
Imaging and treatment records document a torn rotator cuff requiring ongoing physical
therapy, restricted range of motion, and pain that interferes with daily work and
household activities. Our client's treating physicians have not yet cleared him for
full duty, and future care may be necessary.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured's own statement acknowledges that the
signal had changed before the vehicle entered the intersection. We have enclosed the
medical records, billing statements, wage loss documentation, and photographs of the
vehicle damage.
Accordingly, we demand payment of $176,000.00 to reoslve all clamis against your
insured arising from this incident. This offer remains open for thirty days from the
date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period,
we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Christian Carter, pain management physician
Sincerely,
Laura Bryant
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
